name: Fixture 1: two bare cantilevers
note: Spec 5 fixture 1, issue W2-07. Two lines from the two marked surfaces and nothing else: line 1 runs from surface 1 to free tip node 2, line 2 from surface 2 to free tip node 4, and nothing joins the tips. Each line is 0.4 room units, an 8 m cantilever at the 20x scale.
description: Positions are room units (Y up) and go through the scale adapter at Constants.Scale.RoomToBridge. Lines are stored as drawn, vertex to vertex; FixtureCalibrationTests divides each one the way the game does, with EqualSegments.SnapPolyline at Constants.Snapping.TargetSpacingMeters, which keeps these node ids. One static solve carries Constants.Human.CarMassKg * Constants.Loads.Gravity downward in bridge-world, split equally across tipNodeIds. Every member uses the Constants.Section tube with the Constants.Human material, so the file holds no section. The worst-member utilization must be at least Constants.Human.Fixture1MinimumUtilization.
